project_type: Kotlin Spring Boot + Vert.x web reader application
build_system: Gradle (build.gradle.kts), Kotlin 1.5.21, Spring Boot 2.1.6.RELEASE, Vert.x 3.8.5, Java target 1.8
test_framework: No test directory found in source
verification_instructions: Run ./gradlew build -x test to confirm compilation passes
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/main/resources/simple-web/ and src/main/resources/web/ contain compiled frontend assets checked into git
setup_instructions: Java 11 available via mise. Run ./gradlew build -x test
key_patterns: Controllers extend BaseController(coroutineContext). Routes registered in YueduApi.initRouter(). BookController methods are suspend functions returning ReturnData. editShelfBook(book, userNameSpace) { existBook -> ... } pattern for updating shelf books. getUserNameSpace(context) for namespace. checkAuth(context) for auth check.
directory_structure: src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/api/ - API layer (YueduApi.kt routes, controller/ subfolder). src/main/java/com/htmake/reader/db/ - DB layer (DB.kt, JSONTable.kt, SQLTable.kt). src/main/java/io/legado/app/data/entities/ - Data entities (Book.kt etc). src/main/resources/ - Static resources (simple-web/, web/)
